title: Photo Recover&Backup
summary: Focus on Photo, Video and Multi-format File Recovery
description:
Whether you've accidentally deleted photos, lost videos, or mistakenly erased various types of files, Photo Recover & Backup provides you with simple and reliable data recovery and backup solutions. No professional skills required—its clear functions help you retrieve precious memories and back up important data.

【Core Features】
🖼️Accidentally Deleted Photo Recovery: Provides a corresponding recovery process for accidentally deleted photo files, helping you retrieve the lost photo data;
📑Multi-type File Recovery: Supports the recovery of various common file types besides photos, covering the needs of retrieving accidentally deleted documents, audio, and other formatted files;
🎬Precious Video Recovery: Targets important video files accidentally deleted by users, retrieves the deleted video data through the video recovery function, and reduces the risk of losing precious video materials;
🔒File Backup Function: Supports users to back up important files regularly, lowering the probability of file loss caused by equipment failure, incorrect operation, etc.

【Function Highlights】
✨Intuitive Operation: With a concise interface and clear workflow, even beginners can get started quickly;

Photo Recover & Backup focuses on core functions with a concise and straightforward operation process and no redundant designs. It provides practical and reliable tool support for users who need file recovery and video backup!

Important Notice:

This app can only search for and recover photos, videos, and other files in the phone's storage that match specific path patterns. All operations are completed locally on the device, and we will not upload any privacy related information.

If you have restored the phone to factory settings, previously deleted files will not be recoverable. File recovery depends on your device model, storage medium, and file system status, and some files may not be retrievable.
